note: Sources are external comparators only. Values retain their original boundary and evidence class. sources.title: 3D-Printed Dual-Gradient Gel Electrodes Synchronize Ion Transport and Active-Site Utilization for High-Energy Zinc-Ion Hybrid Supercapacitors
sources.permitted_use: Research comparator for stepwise multi-ink 3D-printed dual-gradient MXene/polypyrrole@CNT gel electrodes: electrolyte-facing region with larger microlattice openings, lower micron-scale porosity and higher specific surface area; current-collector side with smaller openings, higher micron-scale porosity and coarser transport pores; micro-CT verification of geometry; COMSOL-predicted suppression of concentration polarization and homogenized reaction-current distribution; abstract-reported 42.7 mg cm-2 loading, 6.2 F cm-2 areal capacitance, 0.86 mWh cm-2 areal energy, 71.1% retention across a 40-fold current-density increase and 98.8% after 15,000 cycles
sources.prohibited_inference: COMSOL local reaction-current maps are simulated, not direct current measurements; micro-CT verifies geometry, not local reaction current. Abstract does not establish complete-device gravimetric/volumetric denominator, full inactive-mass or packaging boundary, process yield, independent-lab reproducibility or commercial performance. Data are stated by authors to be available from corresponding author on reasonable request; obtain supporting information and any needed data/rights before exact reproduction. Do not infer Wh/kg or Wh/L, and do not conflate with the distinct July 2026 carbon/Zn pouch-cell comparator.

sources.title: All 3D Printed Load-bearing Zn-ion Hybrid Supercapacitors

sources.prohibited_inference: Abstract does not provide complete structural design allowables, stiffness/strength/fatigue, complete-device Wh/kg or Wh/L, full component mass, coupled mechanical-electrochemical ageing, independent-lab replication or commercial readiness. Review supporting information and request data under appropriate rights; do not infer structural credit or complete assembly mass savings from the abstract.

sources.title: Experimental investigation of supercapacitor dynamics: charge–discharge performance analysis under system uncertainties
sources.permitted_use: Dynamic-load and uncertainty comparator. The paper reports a 20-cell pack of series-connected 2.7 V, 100 F cells (54 V nominal), an approximately 54 V to 33 V open-circuit voltage decline over 24 h at 25 °C in its setup, effective capacitance falling from 99% of nominal at 1 A to 77% at 10 A constant current and 60% at 200 W constant power, plus a two-branch equivalent-circuit model reducing voltage-prediction RMSE by 49%–83% across the evaluated conditions.
sources.prohibited_inference: Single study and setup; do not use its 24 h decline or 60%–77% high-rate effective-capacitance values as a universal EDLC decay/derating law, product rating or SOTA value. The two-branch RMSE result is in the authors' evaluated cases and is not a cross-device generalization claim. Preserve exact load, device, temperature, uncertainty and measurement boundaries.
sources.authors: Mohammed Shijas V.; Santanu Kumar Dash
